request.style: English, cinematic orchestral, rich female mezzo vocal, string orchestra, harp, French horn, woodwinds, timpani, majestic and reflective, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
At Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night
Ask what I should give you
I am only a young man
I do not know how to go out or come in
Not gold, not years, not victory, but this is what he prayed

[Chorus]
Give your servant a listening heart
To judge your people
To discern between good and evil
A listening heart, a listening heart

[Verse]
Seven years of cedar and of stone cut at the quarry
No hammer and no iron tool was heard upon the hill
The cloud filled the house of the LORD
And the priests could not stand to minister
But will God really dwell on the earth
The heavens, even the highest heaven, cannot contain you

[Verse]
Three thousand proverbs flowed from him like rivers to the sea
His fame went out to every land and kings came there to see
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom
And knowledge of the Holy One is understanding

[Bridge]
But when Solomon grew old his heart was led astray
To other gods and silver, and he wandered from the way
Futility of futilities
Everything is futile
The end of the matter, now that all has been heard
Fear God and keep his commandments

[Chorus]
Give your servant a listening heart
To judge your people
To discern between good and evil
A listening heart, a listening heart
